note: The devnet deploy of the registry: one row per stamp, from the person proof. Public keys, addresses and signatures only. Every key comes from the devnet phrase by the recipe in registry/devnet/deploy.sh, which writes the keypairs outside the repo and checks them against `keys`; the program id's label is registry-person-program. Written by registry/devnet/deploy.sh and registry/client/scripts/devnet.ts; read by registry/client/test/devnet.test.ts. Until the deploy, `registry` and `row` are missing. `earlier` names the registries before this one.

earlier.note: The registry before this one: rows from Semaphore's membership proof against an issuer's signed list, key label registry-rows-program. Left behind on 2026-10-07 when the row changed: still on devnet, still upgradable by the deploy key, nothing closes it, and its rows stay. Its full record, with its rows and transactions, is registry/devnet/devnet.json at commit cad2831.
The first registry: lists, a code tree, a fee. Closed on 2026-09-30 (`registry.closed`). Its full record, with its transactions and registration, is devnet/devnet.json at commit 419837b.

deployCost.note: computed before the deploy by devnet/deploy.sh (lamports), and the deploy key's balance before and after it

closed.what: closed: superseded by the registry in registry/devnet/devnet.json (Hyh5…), its program data's deposit returned to the deploy key. Its config, list, code tree and codes stay as accounts no program owns any more, readable, their rent locked for good; nothing can register here again.

earlier.note: An earlier registry, key label registry-badges-program. Closed on 2026-09-30. Its record is registry/devnet/devnet.json at commit 0abdd13, under `earlier`.
The registry before this one. Closed when this one was deployed (commit aa9be9d). Its record is registry/devnet/devnet.json at commit 0abdd13.
